premises.text: Travelers are obsessed with elite status and reward points but struggle to optimize them
A dashboard organizes air/hotel/car reward balances, personal value, growth, expiry risk, and peer rank
premises.evidence_span: a super smart dashboard that organizes all your points in one spot

premises.text: Deep analysis of spending patterns projects accrual and recommends cards/actions that bump status sooner
premises.evidence_span: the technology that we developed to track your value over time and project it forward

premises.text: Destination and ticket planning overlays points-vs-cash and partner offers for best personal value not just cheapest fare
premises.evidence_span: let you know if you're better off paying with points or cash

premises.text: Huge unused points pool and travel e-commerce inefficiencies create a large addressable opportunity
premises.evidence_span: 17 to 22 trillion unused points valued at half a trillion dollar and more

premises.text: Free-for-consumer Mint-like model monetizes via referral fees from airlines and reward cards when users save
premises.evidence_span: we make money off the referral fee that we get not from the user, but rather from the airlines, the reward cards

premises.text: No competitor combines travel-rewards analysis, expense focus, and historical offer matching
premises.evidence_span: there is no company today that analyzes your travel rewards

value.text: Help travelers become savvy by earning more points, getting status faster, and spending points more wisely
value.evidence_span: our goal at Superfly is to help you become one

causal_links.evidence_span: If Clooney's character is the ultimate savvy traveler, our goal at Superfly is to help you become one
figure out which offer is best suited for you
When the user saves, we make money off the referral fee

notes: Balance/snapshot/rank/sign-up cascade folded into dashboard premise (§4.1.7). Projection/card recommendation kept as core analysis mechanism. Competitor typology folded into gap premise with P1. Enterprise monetization mentioned but free consumer+referrals coded as primary commercial. Three domains—anti-template: need/gap, product, market/monetization separately revisable.
